header:
University of Oklahoma-Norman
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s applicants seeking a PhD must choose MA, not the direct PhD category.
• MathJobs fee-waiver submission is not the official admission application, but timely submission preserves the
deadline.
• US bachelor’s admission English exemption does not automatically satisfy TA certification.
• Kimball Martin moved to Osaka Metropolitan University in 2025 and is listed by OU as a visitor during parts of
2026/27. The older OU research-area listing should not be read as a regular OU advising appointment. Jonathan
Kujawa is now at Oregon State; do not rely on old OU pages.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A bachelor’s degree must be completed before enrollment; applicants may apply with up to three semesters
remaining. Mathematics usually expects GPA 3.0 but states no hard departmental minimum. Bachelor’s
applicants with doctoral intent should choose the MA route; PhD entry is for applicants already holding a
mathematics master’s. The terminal MS is a separate route. [s1] [s5]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select MA if entering from UChicago with doctoral intent. No advance adviser agreement is required.
Applicants seeking a fee waiver first submit a separate MathJobs mini-application and wait for the
department’s decision before completing the official graduate application within the subsequently assigned
window. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No faculty commitment is needed and naming a prospective adviser is not required by mathematics. Current
research faculty may be contacted about fit, but no availability is assumed. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MathJobs is only the fee-waiver application; the official OU graduate application must still be completed.
Central status emails and portal track the admission process; international financial documentation and F-1
transfer instructions follow admission. [s3] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
The mathematics admissions page and MathJobs posting explicitly cover Fall 2027. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
January 15, 2027 for full Fall 2027 consideration; later applications may be considered through April or until
places fill. A timely MathJobs fee-waiver application counts as meeting this deadline, followed by a
department-assigned official application window. The normal portal timezone is not published. [s1] [s3]

Reference receipt [Conflict]
Current admissions and MathJobs instructions require three letters by January 15, 2027. A separate advice
page still says January 12; the cycle-specific January 15 instruction is stronger evidence, but send letters early
if possible. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Provide applicable English proof with the application; review will not proceed without it, and official scores are
necessary before a decision can be finalized. No independent later score grace period was found. GRE scores
are optional. [s1] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
The mathematics department says it does not require a response before April 15. The actual dated response
instruction should be read in the admission/funding offer. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Current central minimums: old TOEFL 79 with each section 20, new TOEFL 4.5 with each section 4; IELTS 6.5
with each section 6; PTE 60 with each section 55; DET 130 with each section 115 under its pilot. Scores must
be under two years old at enrollment. No MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Departmental older IELTS 6
language should not override the newer central 6.5 rule. [s1] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completion of 24 credit hours at an accredited US institution, or an earned US bachelor’s degree, can establish
admission English proficiency. UChicago coursework therefore provides an apparent route before graduation;
confirm how quarter credits are evaluated. Teaching certification is separate: a US bachelor’s alone does not
meet the listed bachelor’s-plus-master’s exemption pathway. [s6] [s7]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
Not required for the current application; the department encourages available GRE evidence and the MathJobs
waiver permits optional scores. No mandatory score threshold is established. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters from people familiar with mathematical work. The department’s advice asks writers to assess
preparation, research potential, motivation, comparative strength, maturity, and teaching-related experience.
[s3] [s4]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
The separate MathJobs fee-waiver application requires three references through MathJobs. Whether letters can
be transferred automatically into the official OU application is not established. This is a fee-waiver process, not
a scholarship reference requirement. [s3]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission; Updating and reusing letters
[Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The official application has an online status page and admissions sends missing-document emails; a
letter-specific receipt display was not explicitly verified. MathJobs has a separate reference workflow. [s6]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Entering base stipend is advertised as USD 23,000, with full tuition and medical insurance; student fees remain
the student’s responsibility. The public page does not clearly identify the stipend’s month basis. Summer
opportunities are separately described as USD 3,500-4,500 and are not guaranteed. [s2]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Support is described for six years, with extensions by request and continued satisfactory performance. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Successful MA/PhD-track applicants are offered teaching support; international terminal-MS students are not

offered departmental assistantships. Admission-level English proficiency does not substitute for teaching
certification. [s1] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Teaching assignments and satisfactory academic progress apply; first-year teaching loads are lighter and
pre-semester preparation is required. Specific offer terms control renewal. [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
TA consideration is automatic with the graduate application. Competitive recruiting fellowships are nominated
by the department. [s1] [s2]
Other funding routes [Conflict]
Recruiting fellowships can provide up to USD 5,000/year; do not add this maximum to the base as a
guaranteed award. The page also uses an up-to-USD-27,000 heading, so confirm the actual combined offer. [s2]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 100 for international applicants; USD 50 for US citizens/permanent residents. [s5] [s6]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
Mathematics offers merit/suitability-based waivers to applicants regardless of circumstances, including
international applicants. Submit the separate MathJobs materials by January 15, 2027 at 23:59:59 (timezone
unstated). Wait for the waiver decision, then use the assigned official application window whether or not the
waiver is granted. Central claims of no waivers do not erase this department-specific route. [s3] [s6]
